text: get_noise_map() exposes main acoustic controls used Noise_level_from_source.groovy. defaults deliberately moderate screening maps; increasing propagation distance, reflection order, diffraction, ray export can make run much slower. Key controls: reflection_order: maximum number specular reflections vertical surfaces. Higher values realistic street canyons much slower. max_src_distance: maximum source-receiver search distance meters. Larger values include farther roads. max_reflection_distance: maximum distance used searching walls reflected paths. diffraction_horizontal diffraction_vertical: enable diffraction horizontal edges around vertical edges. NoiseModelling recommends horizontal diffraction many propagation studies; vertical diffraction mainly rail industrial sources CNOSSOS-EU guidance. wall_alpha: wall absorption coefficient. 0.1 common reflective facade assumption. humidity, temperature, favourable_occurrences: atmospheric absorption meteorological propagation settings. max_error: pruning threshold dB negligible source contributions. smaller value can complete slower. export_source_id: keeps receiver levels source id, useful source contribution diagnostics. rays_name: exports propagation rays attenuation diagnostics table file URL. mainly debugging can large. noise_wps_args: passes named raw arguments NoiseModelling WPS script advanced options yet represented dedicated R argument. OSM traffic defaults used infer_osm_traffic() mirror category values embedded NoiseModelling’s Import_OSM.groovy, including cited Good Practice Guide assumptions. Import_OSM.groovy works local .osm, .osm.gz, .osm.pbf extract; current R workflow instead downloads roads building bounding box applies matching traffic defaults R. already local OSM extract want NoiseModelling create ROADS table , pass osm_file leave roads = NULL. can download regional .osm.pbf extract directly R. osmextract convenient option area available provider Geofabrik: can also download known extract URL base R: uses x buildings ground preparation R, asks NoiseModelling’s Import_OSM.groovy create road network traffic defaults OSM file.

title: gloBFPr 2.0.0
text: Added get_3d_world() export study area (terrain, extruded buildings, canopy trees) Wavefront OBJ /binary STL files direct use Rhino3D Blender. Added get_era5_met() fetch ERA5 reanalysis meteorological conditions (10 m wind, 2 m skin temperature) Copernicus Climate Data Store, pre-formatted inputs prepare_foam_case() Added integrated urban noise mapping workflow: get_noise_map() prepare_noisemodelling_inputs() prepare screening-level road-noise inputs building height, OSM roads, canopy height, greenspace data, can run official headless NoiseModelling WPS scripts directly (run = TRUE). install_noisemodelling() installs headless runner. Added infer_osm_traffic() osm_noise_traffic_defaults() derive screening-level traffic speed/volume defaults OSM road class observed counts unavailable. Added pedestrian-level wind simulation support built OpenFOAM, run inside Docker via run_openfoam_docker(): prepare_foam_case(), prepare_openfoam_inputs(), post-processing/plotting helpers sample_foam_slice(), read_foam_pedestrian_slice(), plot_foam_map(), add_flow_vectors(). Added generate_block() aggregate_block() aggregate individual-building metrics block-level summaries city-scale analysis. aggregate_block(population = TRUE) fetches GHSL population directly block level (pop_total), aggregate_block(residential = TRUE) computes block-level residential built-surface proportion (res_prop) directly GHS rasters, rather aggregating per-building estimates. Added get_neighbors() neighboring-building counts centroid distance summaries within fixed-radius buffer. Added get_bgvi() (Building Green View Index, following Qi et al. 2024) get_dng() (distance nearest green space), built viewscape package (now requires viewscape >= 2.0.1).
